# goslop text fixture — CWE-93 outgoing client / numeric-only header writes (safe)
lang: python
file: CWE-93-response-header-safe.py
---
USER_AGENT = "httptap/1.0"


def configure_client(client) -> None:
    client.headers["User-Agent"] = USER_AGENT


def set_shape_headers(tensor, response) -> None:
    if hasattr(tensor, "shape"):
        response.headers["X-Tenso-Shape"] = str(tensor.shape)
    if hasattr(tensor, "dtype"):
        response.headers["X-Tenso-Version"] = "4"
